body: A wound around visibility and creative worth: a fear that you are not special, paired with a need to be.
business: You help others step into their own light without shame.
shadow: Hiding your gifts, or demanding constant validation for them.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
